page_title: ATM 4-1 BET | Atletico Madrid v Betis 18/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+16' That's the end of the match.
90+15' Pablo Fornals (Betis) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
90+12' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90+10' Pablo Fornals (Betis) is adjudged offside.
90+9' Julian Alvarez comes off the pitch to be replaced by Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid).
90+6' 4 - 1 Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) beats the offside trap and bears down on goal. With just the keeper to beat he coolly shoots past him from the edge of the box.
90+5' The corner by Isco (Betis) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
90+3' Adrian Cordero shows a yellow card to Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) for a tough tackle.
90' 15 additional min. will be played.
89' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Nobel Mendy (Betis).
88' The goal by Atl. Madrid is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
86' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
85' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the right post.
84' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
82' We are about to witness a substitution. Angel Ortiz (Betis) is replacing Aitor Ruibal.
82' It will be a substitution. William Carvalho (Betis) is ready to enter the pitch as Giovani Lo Celso walks off.
81' Atl. Madrid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
80' Diego Simeone has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) replacing Giuliano Simeone.
80' Substitution. Samuel Lino did his best and is replaced by Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid).
79' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Isco (Betis) takes it short.
78' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Jan Oblak makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the roof of the net.
78' Isco (Betis) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
77' Isco (Betis) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Jan Oblak easily deals with the threat.

75' 3 - 1 Goal! Antoine Griezmann manages to prod the ball to Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the middle of the goal. 3:1.
74' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
74' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
73' The attendance for today's match is 62269.
72' Pablo Fornals (Betis) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
71' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Adrian Cordero no option but to blow his whistle.
70' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Rodrigo de Paul will be replaced by Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid).
70' The game has come to an end for Alexander Sorloth. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid).
67' 2 - 1 What a hit! Pablo Fornals (Betis) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot inside the right post. 2:1.
66' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
65' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) was too forceful with his tackle and Adrian Cordero interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
64' The match can continue after the interruption.
56' The game is interrupted.
54' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
52' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He sends a shot towards the right post, but it is denied by the goalkeeper with a superb save.
51' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
49' Antony (Betis) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the bottom right corner lacks power and Jan Oblak easily makes the save.
47' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Adrian Cordero has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Betis are awarded the free kick.
46' Substitution. Abde Ezzalzouli makes way for Antony (Betis).
46' Here is a change. Cedric Bakambu is going off and Manuel Pellegrini gives the last tactical orders to Cucho Hernandez (Betis).
46' A substitution has been made. Sergi Altimira is replaced by Isco (Betis).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' Adrian Cordero has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+3' 2 - 0 Goal! Samuel Lino swings the ball deep into the box and finds Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the right side of the goal. 2:0.
45+3' The resulting corner from Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
45+2' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
45+1' Koke (Atl. Madrid) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' A pass by Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
42' The keeper makes a simple save after Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) received a short pass and shot low from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal.

39' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Adrian guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
39' A pass from Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is intercepted by Adrian and the move breaks down.
38' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Jan Oblak.
36' A dangerous towering header by Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
36' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
34' Sergi Altimira (Betis) commits a rough challenge and Adrian Cordero blows his whistle for a foul.

33' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball hits the right post and ricochets away.
32' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) takes the corner kick, but Jan Oblak reads it well and stops the effort.
31' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis). The linesman points to the corner flag, Betis are going to take it.
31' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
29' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) wins the ball in the box, but curls his effort high over the bar.
27' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
26' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
25' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Adrian Cordero blows his whistle for a foul.
22' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
21' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Adrian Cordero blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
15' The Betis players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
13' The foul by Cedric Bakambu (Betis) was seen by Adrian Cordero who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
12' The ball is cleared after Cedric Bakambu (Betis) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

10' 1 - 0 Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) unleashes a beautiful rocket of a shot from a long-range free kick. The ball goes into the top right corner and leaves the goalkeeper beaten. This takes hours and hours on the training ground. The score is 1:0.
9' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
6' Atl. Madrid fail to score from a corner as Adrian (Betis) leaps to collect the ball.
5' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The linesman makes the right call and Atl. Madrid will have a corner.
4' The shot by Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Adrian.
3' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
2' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Betis will have the kick-off.
Adrian Cordero will supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
